info.title: GetOdds data gateway
info.description: The Odds API v4-compatible routes at every GetOdds book (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Pinnacle, Novig) with per-event player props and scores; DraftKings and FanDuel DFS slates and salaries; Player props at every book (FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers, Pinnacle, Novig, PrizePicks, Underdog, DK Pick6) with line history, Novig exchange prices, scoped player thresholds from four sources, DraftKings-via-ESPN prices, native FanDuel and BetRivers US-PA prices, and explicitly bounded analysis and evidence APIs. Price analysis is conditional; computed assessments are not official sportsbook settlements.

get.summary: Player props at every book, merged per player, stat and game day
get.description: Open to every valid key; one credit per page. Pregame lines for games in the next 48 hours from FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers, Pinnacle and Novig (two-sided prices) and PrizePicks, Underdog and DK Pick6 (pick’em lines). Each row carries every book’s quote, the median line, the best over and under, a no-vig fair price and the largest pick’em gap. Sources are read at most every 2 minutes.

get.summary: Line and price history of one prop quote, with its open and close
get.description: Open to every valid key; one credit. Pass the book and a quote id from /api/v1/props (quotes with history=true). Points are oldest first. close is the last quote at or before the start (closed=true once the game has started). FanDuel: every new line, line move, price move and removal. PrizePicks: every new, changed, pulled and restored line. Novig: best-bid changes (about 30 days kept) with the no-vig fair open and close. Underdog: change-only main-line history. DraftKings: every change of the market’s main line and both prices (New Jersey, else New York). Pick6 (book=pick6 or dk_pick6): the first stored sighting of the main line, then every main-line move, pause and restore.

get.summary: Novig exchange pregame prices: game lines and player props
get.description: Open to every valid key; one credit per page. Novig is a no-vig exchange: price_american and price_decimal convert the ask (the price a taker gets, 1 minus the best bid on the other side), fair is the no-vig mid. Pregame markets carry no taker fee. Open markets seen in the last 20 minutes, starting in the next 7 days. is_main marks the most balanced strike per event and market (per player for props).

get.summary: Read BetRivers US-PA native pregame priced markets
get.description: Requires an explicit betrivers source grant AND selected bookmaker before upstream I/O. Existing keys gain no automatic grant. One shared credit per successful page. One bounded fixed-host native request, no credentials or redirects. Only future NOT_STARTED events and native OPEN priced outcomes. Preserves native criterion lifetime/occurrence, IDs, independent American/decimal display values, and per-outcome changedDate. No fabricated odds, historical retention, canonical mapping or settlement equivalence. League lists are partial; use event_id for event detail. Unknown/repeated queries fail. See /docs/betrivers.

post.summary: Provisionally assess retained contracts against verified final scores
post.description: DraftKings source grant and selected bookmaker required before contract retrieval. Policy completed-game-score-v1 supports NFL/NBA/NCAAF/NCAAB full-game moneyline, spread and total; integer/half lines only. Counts reported final scores, including any overtime represented there, without verifying bookmaker overtime/abandonment/void rules. Ties/equal thresholds produce a computed push, not an official adjudication. Nonstandard final statuses, unsupported contracts and missing retained snapshots are ungradeable. Nonfinal pre/in events are pending. Source failures remain503, never void. Max50 selections from one event per request; JSON body max32KiB. Required customer-scoped Idempotency-Key freezes the response for that request body; changed body returns409. Use a new key to observe a newer provider revision. Each successful call, including cached replay, costs one credit and request allowance.

get.summary: Analyze conditional recent stored-price arbitrage
get.description: Requires BOTH draftkings and fanduel key grants AND both selected bookmakers under locked admission before source I/O. One shared credit per successful page. Conditional normal-completed-game analysis only: no verified settlement equivalence, execution, fees, limits or true probabilities. Basketball two-way moneylines; basketball/football matching half-point spreads/totals only. Exact native type allowlists and atomic DraftKings pre-state batch freshness. Full candidate universes matched before filtering/pagination; default exact event starts, explicit bounded_time maximum120s. Collector observation clocks, not live execution quotes. Empty results are bounded sample statements. Unknown/repeated query parameters fail. See /docs/opportunity-feeds.

get.summary: Read conservative DraftKings-to-FanDuel event metadata associations
get.description: Requires BOTH draftkings and fanduel key grants before either source read, but no bookmaker price selection. One credit per successful page. Includes unmatched and ambiguous DraftKings anchors. Only unique exact sport/league and normalized full HOME/AWAY names match, with UTC starts at most 1800 seconds apart (books publish different start clocks for the same game); the same teams repeated within 12 hours require identical starts. Normalization is NFC, lowercase and whitespace only. No aliases or nickname guesses. Native FanDuel team evidence requires two explicit HOME/AWAY runners on non-future game moneylines. This is bounded observed metadata, not canonical identity, comparable market contracts or arbitrage. DraftKings schedule metadata must be observed within 3 hours and FanDuel market metadata within 15 minutes. The entire bounded universe is matched before cursor pagination; clipped candidate sets fail with 422. Repeated/unknown parameters are rejected.

get.summary: Read last retained offer snapshots before the stored scheduled start
get.description: DraftKings grant and selected bookmaker required. One credit per successful page. Selects the last retained price per market, period and side observed strictly before the current stored scheduled start, within lookback_hours (default 48, max 168), over history that is kept, not aged out. History stores price changes only, so each row reports closed_at and minutes_before_start, and meta.last_collected_at is the last collector pass for the event before start. Superseded spread/total lines are excluded. Ties use greatest sequence. Not an official closing price or verified actual kickoff. No stale substitution, jurisdiction guarantee, complete capture, settlement or value signal. Future scheduled start returns409; known event without eligible history returns200 with empty data.

get.summary: Stream bounded retained-change pages over authenticated WebSocket
get.description: Actual WebSocket upgrade on the Node/Fluid runtime. Server-side clients must send Authorization: Bearer; credentials in URLs and cookie-only authentication are not supported. Uses the replay cursor/filter contract, polling retained changes every five seconds. Upgrade admission costs zero credits; each successful poll/page costs one shared credit, including empty polls, and consumes shared request allowance. Maximum two active connections per customer across keys; each closes after at most 240 seconds with 1012. Every poll rechecks revocation, scope, account bookmaker selection and lease. This does not change source collection frequency or guarantee complete capture. Save after/through only after processing every row in a received page; reconnect from that client checkpoint. No application messages are accepted.

get.summary: Resume bounded retained offer changes by sequence
get.description: One source-scoped SQL snapshot per request. First request uses after=0 and omits through to capture the current upper source sequence. Continue with next_after and the same through/filters until replay_complete, then omit through for the next poll. after/through anchors greater than zero must exist in the retained source history or the response is410 RESYNC_REQUIRED. Numeric sequence holes do not prove missing updates. Upper watermark is not a frozen cross-request snapshot. Capture completeness, arbitrary middle-row deletion detection, lifecycle deletion messages and streaming are not provided. Requires DraftKings scope and account bookmaker selection; one successful page costs one credit.
